The '''TX-130T fighter tank''', also known as the '''IFT-T''', was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Hovertank/Legends|combat assault tank]] manufactured by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]].

==Description==
[[File:Rep_Vehicle_sizes.jpg|thumb|left|Size comparison of an [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]], [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|Chariot LAV]] and a TX-130T.]]
The 8.2 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long TX-130T was an upgraded version of the [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] employed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], faster than its speed of 193 km/hour, making it faster and more agile. It was crewed by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. It was also categorized as the IFT-T.<ref name="PrimaBF2" /> The [[Tank/Legends|tank]] had a capacity of 100 kilograms of cargo, carried supplies for one day of operation, and had room for up to five passengers.<ref name="TFUCG" />

It was armed with a single top-mounted [[Beam cannon turret/Legends|beam cannon turret]], two heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on either side of the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], and a pair of computer-guided [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] along the hull. The launchers fired [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]<ref name="PrimaBF2" /> or [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], with a payload of eight missiles.<ref name="TFUCG" /> The top cannon's gunner lacked shielding around most of his body, allowing enemy [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] to easily target a stationary vehicle and kill the gunner.<ref name="BF II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> The TX-130T was used to support [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] assaults and was also used in an anti-armor role.<ref name="PrimaBF1" /> It also saw use as a fast raider or as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]]. One cost 42,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new, and 34,000 credits used.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==History==
<div style="float:right">[[File:TX-tank.jpg|thumb|Two TX-130Ts during the [[Cleansing of New Plympto|Battle of]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]].]]</div>
The first units were deployed towards the end of the Clone Wars<ref name="TFUCG" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> but the tank model would be best known for its use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] before and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The tank saw action on various planets and battlefields such as [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. When [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] were present in battle, the tank escorted the larger [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].<ref name="BF II" /> [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] planners attempted to remove the TX-130T from service during the rise of the Empire, but few other models had proven as useful in rooting out insurgents.<ref name="TFUCG" />

These vehicles were used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces during the [[Battle of Turak IV]].<ref name="TBoT4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The TX-130T first appeared in the Star Wars: the Clone Wars video game, and in the [[Star Wars Battlefront (series)|''Battlefront'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series as an Imperial vehicle. It was a re-skinned Republic TX-130S. The tank has since appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times: The Path to Nowhere]]'' comic story arc.
